candidate.title: Bastet reported plausibly compromised
candidate.summary: A public issue reports that bastet's machine is very plausibly compromised and requests removal of its existing entry from the software. The report says its current keys cannot be trusted.
candidate.why_it_matters: This incident affects the trust model of the Tor network's directory authorities, requiring operators to update their configurations to exclude the compromised node.

passages.text: dirauth: Remove bastet from list
Last night, bastet's operator notified us that the machine is very plausibly compromised.
In any kind of scenario here, the keys can't be trusted anymore and bastet will generate a new identity soon.
In the meantime, remove bastet from source as we can't trust it anymore.
